item: Row K: the bulletin carrier for the OpenStreetMap completeness card
summary: The bulletin's cards section runs the lane producers, records the lane cards it shows (lane_cards_shown), and the edition's attribution block credits OpenStreetMap and the ODbL 1.0 line against exactly those through a card:<producer> signal (attribution.OSM_DERIVED_CARDS), so D's OpenStreetMap tag completeness card is no longer held (held_q823) from bulletins. The lead report and the card audit have no attribution block and keep the hold. A test fails if a lane-only producer has no attribution mapping.
